title: On the Number of Limit Cycles in Generalized Abel Equations with Coefficients Having the Chebyshev Property
summary: This paper concerns the maximum number of limit cycles of generalized Abel differential equations $dx/dt = A(t)x^p + B(t)x^q$, where $A$ and $B$ belong to the linear span of a family of functions having the Chebyshev property. Motivated by a recent open problem posed by Huang et al. (Nonlinearity, 2026), we investigate whether this maximum number can be bounded in terms of $p$, $q$, and the structure of the family.
